# git-third-party

> 标签: git, submodule, subtree, third-party, vendoring

## 简介

Vendor third-party Git repositories into your own, with path filtering and local patches. CLI plus in-process Node bindings.

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/khwstolle/git-third-party
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/khwstolle/git-third-party.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/git-third-party

## 历史版本号

- 当前版本：1.0.0

- 0.0.1
- 1.0.0

## 获取地址

- npm 安装：`npm install git-third-party`
- npm registry：https://registry.npmjs.org/git-third-party
- Node 要求：>=18
